synth.notes:
Mirror-axis game on a 3x3 block grid (x=row): wall axis row ax, holed pieces, solid targets, gray reflections; A5 cycles axis->pieces (largest first)->axis.
Selected axis moves A1/A2 (+-3 rows) and may overlap piece rows (step 71: piece on axis row, axis moves up; there is no blocking). Selected piece moves A1-A4, blocked by the board edge and by other pieces.
Reflection block = (2*ax-bx, by), skipping on-axis sources and piece-occupied dests. The step-71 target/wall/reflection changes come only from re-rendering and occlusion.
Render layers wall<target<reflection<piece, then re-extract: 4-conn comps per type ranked by bbox (x,y); wall/piece ranks also count 0-dot comps; targets per sprite are re-ranked by visible bbox.
Also 30/30 with hidden state disabled. Unconfirmed: A5 order after a piece is selected, A7 (not observed).
